submission.hypothesis: A finite-dimensional observable state updated by token-conditioned linear operators may explain the neural predictions. The method chooses its dimension from held-out public sequences. This is a representation hypothesis, not a declaration that the original process family has been identified.
submission.assumptions: Built-in finite-dimensional linear predictive-state prior; time-homogeneous operators; a rank identifiable from one-symbol prefix/suffix moments; sampled triples; signed coordinates with the declared numerical repairs. Vocabulary bounds the searched dimension. No supplied hidden-state count or process constructor.

resources.access_used: cached tokens and next-token probabilities only
resources.dimension_search: every numerically supported dimension up to vocabulary size; all trials in selection.json
resources.training: spectral factorization followed by public sequence validation and full-cache refit
